outcomes.CANDIDATE: all validation and confirmation criteria pass -> NOT a release: first a preregistered paper session on new data (Binance Spot testnet klines, at least 8 weeks after registration, S06/S07 runner with the operator's keys) with its own criteria; only then S08 criteria for a new release
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 15 closed trades on validation, no configuration eligible on development, or validation passes and confirmation fails

validation: closed_trades_per_year <= 30% of the momentum_v1 baseline on the same window
costs <= 50% of the gross result (net + costs)

buy_and_hold.description: constant LONG at max_exposure for the whole window (context only)

momentum_v1.description: btcusdt-momentum-v1: threshold 0.0, horizon 6 (reference for the turnover criterion, as in E01 and E03)

checkpoints.check: Feature and strategy causality: tests/test_mean_reversion.py green on the run commit (z-score from closes strictly before the event, undefined across gaps, crossing entry, exit at the mean, fail closed).
Grid of 12 configurations reproducible (same ledger digests on two runs in separate output directories); selection.json from development only, committed before validation is run.
report.json per window for the selected configuration and the baselines with the declared metrics; outcome justified on the criteria.
If CANDIDATE: preregistered testnet paper session specification before any S08 step; else closing evidence in the backlog.

spec.command: python -m crypto_decision_lab.reversion_experiment develop --spec config/experiments/E04-mean-reversion-v1.json; commit selection.json; python -m crypto_decision_lab.reversion_experiment evaluate --spec config/experiments/E04-mean-reversion-v1.json
spec.hypothesis: Inside an uptrend (close above its 720h average), a sharp short-term drop of the hourly close below its recent mean (z-score crossing under -entry_z) tends to revert to that mean within a few days. Buying the crossing and selling at the mean (or at the holding horizon) trades rarely and earns per trade more than the round-trip cost (fee 0.10% + slippage 0.05% per side), so the net return is positive out of sample under the E01 acceptance criteria.

forbidden: BTCUSDT-1h-forward-v1 and any path under data/forward (CP08 reserved)
inputs.protocol: crypto_decision_lab.experiment_protocol (two phases; same selection rule and criteria as E01 and E03)
inputs.strategy: crypto_decision_lab.mean_reversion.MeanReversionStrategy, registered as mean_reversion in simulation.STRATEGIES. zscore = (close(t-1h) - SMA_w) / STD_w on the hourly calendar; entry on the crossing below -entry_z with trend_ratio > 0; exit at zscore >= exit_z or at the holding horizon; regime checked at entry only; missing feature -> FLAT. Features computed over the whole admitted frame (bars before a window only warm up).

validation.use: one evaluation of the selected configuration

origin.data_seen_before_registration: All three windows of BTCUSDT-1h-raw-v1 were already evaluated for momentum (S08, E01, E03) and pattern (E02) strategies. E03 development results informed the fixed regime filter (SMA 720h). No z-score feature and no mean-reversion configuration were evaluated on real data before registration.
origin.deviation: Three momentum variants on BTCUSDT 1h were rejected by the same criteria (S08 baseline, E01, E03): the gross edge of momentum_24h is too small for the costs. E02 (breakout patterns in formation) was rejected too, most exits by invalidation. A different signal family is tested instead of further tuning momentum.
evidence: reports/e03/report.json: REJECTED, validation -4.65% with 8% time in market; SMA 720h regime clearly better than 168h on development

spec.prompt: Lavora esclusivamente sull'esperimento E04 del repository Crypto Decision Lab. Leggi Crypto_Decision_Lab_PRD.md e questa specifica; verifica che il suo sha256 (fine riga LF) coincida con quello registrato nella riga E04 del backlog e che status sia PREREGISTERED. Esegui CP-E04.0 (pytest tests/test_mean_reversion.py), poi la fase develop, committa selection.json, poi la fase evaluate; ripeti con la fase all in una cartella di output diversa e confronta i ledger_sha256 (CP-E04.1). Non modificare specifica, strategia o runner dopo aver visto un risultato: ogni modifica richiede una nuova versione preregistrata. Riporta per CP-E04.0-3 comando, atteso, osservato ed evidenza nel formato di handoff del PRD e aggiorna la riga E04 del backlog con l'esito.
spec.selection_rule: On development only: among configurations with closed_trades >= 30, the highest net_return_pct; ties -> fewer closed trades -> grid order. If none qualifies the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE and validation is not run. selection.json is committed to the repository before validation and confirmation are evaluated.
threats: Fourth experiment on the same snapshot: every window was already seen for other strategies and the regime filter comes from E03 development results. A CANDIDATE is weak evidence; the guard is the forward paper session on new data required by the CANDIDATE outcome.

Mean reversion has a negatively skewed payoff: many small wins and a few large losses when a dip keeps falling. There is no price stop; the holding horizon is the only loss limit, and max_exposure 0.5 caps the size. The drawdown criterion is the registered guard.
Grid of 12 on one asset and one timeframe: multiple-comparison bias on development; validation and confirmation are evaluated once.
Features are undefined for up to 720 hours after each gap (regime SMA): no entries in that time.
